about: Reference viewpoints: a real photo (Wikimedia Commons, free license; downloaded to build/reference/photos, never committed) and the game camera pose that matches it. cam is ?cam=x,y,z,yaw,pitch: x meters east and z meters south of 40.758,-73.9855 in the tiles' transverse mercator projection (game.projection), y meters above sea level, yaw in degrees (0 looks north, positive turns left/west, so yaw = -compass heading), pitch in degrees up. spawn puts the hero 40 m behind the camera, out of sight. photo.hfov is the photo's horizontal field of view from its EXIF 35 mm equivalent focal length; photo.principal is where the optical axis crosses the photo (fractions; default the center; lower for photos straightened in post, whose horizon sits below the middle). camera_lat_lon is the photo's own geotag; pose_note says how the pose was fitted. game.vfov is the free camera's vertical field of view (scenes/world.tscn); game.hud_boxes are screen areas (pixels at 2560x1440, negative = from the right/bottom) kept out of the crops. See docs/REFERENCE.md.
